versions.changelog: Enhanced description with better triggers, expanded tags, setup troubleshooting guide, pro tips, and improved workflow documentation

Initial release of the pexoai-agent skill for AI-powered short video creation.

- Enables users to produce 5–60 second videos for ads, social media, promos, and explainers.
- Handles video creation end-to-end: script, shots, transitions, music.
- Accepts optional file uploads; supports aspect ratios 16:9, 9:16, 1:1.
- Delivers finished videos and project links after processing.
- Responds to users in their chosen language.
